Have you ever been to Brazil

texto.ru: Have you ever been to Japan? I have never been there, but my friend has visited Tokyo twice. She has seen snow, she has tried sushi and she has climbed a mountain. I haven't done any of those things. Have I ever travelled alone? Yes, I have. Once I went to Argentina for a week. It was an unforgettable trip, and I want to do it again.
texto.pt: Você já esteve no Japão? Eu nunca estive lá, mas minha amiga visitou Tóquio duas vezes. Ela já viu neve, já provou sushi e já escalou uma montanha. Eu não fiz nenhuma dessas coisas. Já viajei sozinho? Sim, já. Uma vez fui à Argentina por uma semana. Foi uma viagem inesquecível e quero fazer de novo.

perguntas.pergunta: Has the writer been to Japan?
How many times has the friend visited Tokyo?
Where did the writer travel alone?
